ai_document_issue_page_range.name: ai_document_issue_page_range
ai_document_issue_page_range.value: ("ai_document_issue"."page_from" IS NULL AND "ai_document_issue"."page_to" IS NULL) OR ("ai_document_issue"."page_from" > 0 AND "ai_document_issue"."page_to" >= "ai_document_issue"."page_from")

bulk_product_inquiry_start_window_order.name: bulk_product_inquiry_start_window_order
bulk_product_inquiry_start_window_order.value: "bulk_product_inquiry"."start_window_from" IS NULL OR "bulk_product_inquiry"."start_window_to" IS NULL OR "bulk_product_inquiry"."start_window_to" >= "bulk_product_inquiry"."start_window_from"

bulk_product_inquiry_delivery_window_ord.name: bulk_product_inquiry_delivery_window_order
bulk_product_inquiry_delivery_window_ord.value: "bulk_product_inquiry"."delivery_window_from" IS NULL OR "bulk_product_inquiry"."delivery_window_to" IS NULL OR "bulk_product_inquiry"."delivery_window_to" >= "bulk_product_inquiry"."delivery_window_from"

product_family_subcategory_match.name: product_family_subcategory_match
product_family_subcategory_match.value: ("product"."category" IS NULL OR "product"."family" = 'dom') AND ("product"."spa_subcategory" IS NULL OR "product"."family" = 'spa-modulowe') AND ("product"."container_subcategory" IS NULL OR "product"."family" = 'kontenery-modulowe')

product_timeline_stage_duration_order.name: product_timeline_stage_duration_order
product_timeline_stage_duration_order.value: "product_timeline_stage"."duration_min_days" IS NULL OR "product_timeline_stage"."duration_max_days" IS NULL OR "product_timeline_stage"."duration_max_days" >= "product_timeline_stage"."duration_min_days"

product_variant_price_order.name: product_variant_price_order
product_variant_price_order.value: "product_variant"."price_min_cents" IS NULL OR "product_variant"."price_max_cents" IS NULL OR "product_variant"."price_max_cents" >= "product_variant"."price_min_cents"

project_quote_exactly_one_link.name: project_quote_exactly_one_link
project_quote_exactly_one_link.value: (("project_quote"."project_request_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("project_quote"."bulk_product_inquiry_id" IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

project_request_start_window_order.name: project_request_start_window_order
project_request_start_window_order.value: "project_request"."start_window_from" IS NULL OR "project_request"."start_window_to" IS NULL OR "project_request"."start_window_to" >= "project_request"."start_window_from"

project_request_delivery_window_order.name: project_request_delivery_window_order
project_request_delivery_window_order.value: "project_request"."delivery_window_from" IS NULL OR "project_request"."delivery_window_to" IS NULL OR "project_request"."delivery_window_to" >= "project_request"."delivery_window_from"
